intro: Hello and welcome to the Super Microbe World Game Show!
Soon you will be visiting the weird world of the microbe.
But first, who do you want to play as?
Tell me a little about yourself:
You don't need to give us this information, but if you do you'll be able to take part in competitions and hear about new versions of the game.
Let's see what you know about microbes.

blind: Welcome to the first BLIND QUESTION ROUND!

If you get them right, you'll get a great bonus later though, so try your best.
normal: Well done, you're a hoverboard natural!
